description: Step 2: Teach it the business. Send the owner's message to the setup assistant (conversationId from ringkit_start_setup_chat). The reply lists what was saved in `writes`. Reuse an idempotencyKey when retrying; without one, each call executes again.

businessId.description: Defaults to the business of the API key in the Authorization header.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. Retries of the same call should reuse it (the stored result comes back); a new value deliberately repeats an identical call. The MCP POST's Idempotency-Key header takes precedence.

name: ringkit_send_setup_chat
title: Send setup chat message
